subject: Request: short standby pool for Helio Systems POC (early Aug)
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short standby pool for Helio Systems POC (early Aug)

Hi Monica,

Quick ask — Helio (HEL-2029-092) is moving to a late-stage POC and wants a dedicated slice for the evaluation. Their preferred kickoff is the week of Aug 5 (ideally Aug 6). Can ops confirm whether we can put a short-term standby pool on hold for them (2–4 week soft hold) in us-west with the following target profile?

- Preferred: 8 x A100-80GB (reserved nodes)
- Fallback: 16 x A100-40GB or quantized equivalents for lower-cost inference
- Minimum viable: 24 x A10-class GPUs (for short-burst inference during demos)

We need an internal answer on whether we can place a non-binding hold by EOD Wednesday so I can commit the window with the customer. If full reservation is tight, please surface the exact conflicted windows and a smaller standby option we can offer.

Attached: Helio_MOU_draft.pdf (low-risk MOU they want signed prior to kickoff).

Context: Helio is planning model evals that will hit 2–3k qps for short spikes during demo days; they expect most traffic to be single-turn chat but with long context up to 4k tokens. We've flagged latency sensitivity (p95 < 150ms) and willingness to pay a small premium for dedicated capacity.

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Helio_MOU_draft.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jul 2029 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short standby pool for Helio Systems POC (early Aug)

Diego —

We can support a short-term standby hold but there are some constraints and options to be explicit about. Preliminary availability (US-West region, standard fleet) — subject to final SKU confirmation: 

- Option A (preferred from infra): Reserve 4 x A100-80GB dedicated, with an additional 8 x A100-40GB hot-burst pool (holds for 21 days).
- Option B (cost-optimized): Reserve 12 x A100-40GB (no A100-80s) for the same window.
- Option C (minimal): 24 x A10-class instances for strictly demo-only spikes (non-dedicated).

We have two overlapping commitments during Aug: OrionEdge (Aug 1–20) consumes 6 x A100-80GB and QuantumForge has a loose standby Aug 10–25 (20 x A100-40GB). That means a full 8 x A100-80GB reservation Aug 6–20 would conflict with OrionEdge; we could either: move Helio to Aug 21 start (no conflict) or take Option A but convert 2 of the A100-80GB to A100-40GB for the first two weeks.

Latency-wise, A100-80GB gives the p95 headroom you need; A100-40GB will likely need tighter batching and KV cache tuning to hit 150ms. If the customer will accept quantized runtimes we can advise a 30% cost reduction using int8 paths — we should confirm model family and token mix.

I'll attach the current SKU availability sheet (gpu_sku_list.csv) and link the internal inventory map so you can see the exact node IDs.

Next steps from ops:
1) Confirm hold window (exact start/end).
2) Confirm tentative SKU combo we should hold.
3) Ops will post a tentative hold ticket and lock the nodes for up to 21 days pending final MOU signature.

If you want me to push a firm hold now (soft hold + billing block), I can put a ticket in and mark it as "sales standby: Helio" so it's discovered in the inventory runbook.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Head of Capacity Planning, Redwood Inference

Attachments: gpu_sku_list.csv (text/csv)
Related: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/INF/GPU+Inventory+Map

Subject: Fwd: Request: short standby pool for Helio Systems POC (early Aug)

Sam — forwarding ops note below so we're aligned on capacity. TL;DR: we can put a short soft-hold but there are overlapping commitments in early Aug. Monica outlined three options; please confirm which you prefer so I can lock a window with ops.

Options (summary):
- A: 4x A100-80GB reserved + 8x A100-40GB burst (21-day soft hold) — best latency headroom
- B: 12x A100-40GB reserved — lower cost, more batching required
- C: 24x A10-class (demo spikes only) — minimal, non-dedicated

Does Helio want us to:
1) proceed with Option A but shift the start to Aug 21 to avoid OrionEdge conflict, or
2) proceed Aug 6 with a mixed-sku plan (2x of the A100-80GB converted to A100-40GB for first two weeks), or
3) accept Option B/C and keep Aug 6 start?

Also note: Monica will place a 21-day soft-ticket hold once you confirm. I've attached the MOU draft for signature (DocuSign link ready once you confirm window).

Thanks — Diego

Diego / Monica,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the options — appreciate the clarity. We want the POC to be as close to production conditions as possible, so we prefer a dedicated pool. Given the OrionEdge overlap, our preference is:

- Start: Aug 6 if you can guarantee the mixed-sku plan (convert 2 of the A100-80GB to A100-40GB for Aug 6–20), otherwise move to Aug 21 start window.
- Target: 4x A100-80GB + 8x A100-40GB (mixed as above for the first two weeks)
- Compliance ask: We need disk encryption-at-rest confirmation and daily audit logs for the POC window (logs can be exported to our S3).

We'll sign the MOU once you send the DocuSign envelope for the agreed window. Priya (cc) is our procurement lead and will handle the signature and billing questions.
